description.zh:
可定制数据库文件存储实例使用的CPU核数、内存上限值等。

- cpuCoreCount：CPU核数。
-  memorySize：内存大小，单位MB。
- pageCacheSize：PageCache缓存大小，单位MB。
description.en:
Customize CPU cores, memory limit, and PageCache size for the DBFS instance.

- cpuCoreCount: Number of CPU cores.

- memorySize: Memory size in MB.

- pageCacheSize: PageCache size in MB.

description.zh:
数据库文件系统类型。取值范围：
- standard：标准版
- enterprise：企业版
description.en:
The DBFS edition. Valid values:

- standard: Standard Edition

- enterprise: Enterprise Edition

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)。
description.en: A client token used to ensure idempotence. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html).

description.zh: 使用快照创建DBFS后是否删除原始快照。
description.en: Specifies whether to delete the source snapshot after creating the DBFS instance from it.

description.zh:
是否以RAID方式来创建DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to create the DBFS instance using RAID.

Valid values: true or false. Default value: false.

description.zh:
是否加密DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the DBFS instance.

Valid values: true or false. Default value: false.

description.zh:
数据库文件系统名称。

取值范围：2~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线和连字符（-）。
description.en:
The name of the database file system.

Valid values: 2 to 128 characters. The name must start with an English letter (case-sensitive) or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
实例规格。取值范围：

- dbfs.small

- dbfs.medium

- dbfs.large（默认值）
description.en:
The instance type. Valid values:

- dbfs.small

- dbfs.medium

- dbfs.large (default)
The KMS key ID used by the DBFS instance.

description.zh:
创建DBFS实例时，设置DBFS的性能等级。取值范围：

- PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万

- PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万（默认值）

- PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万

- PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万
description.en:
The performance level of the DBFS instance. Valid values:

- PL0: Up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS per disk

- PL1: Up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk (default)

- PL2: Up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk

- PL3: Up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk

description.zh:
条带数量。当EnableRaid参数为true时必传。

取值范围：2-8之间的整数。
description.en:
The number of stripes. Required when EnableRaid is set to true.

Valid values: 2 to 8.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html).

description.zh:
容量大小，以GiB为单位。指定该参数后，其取值必须≥指定快照ID的容量大小。

取值范围：不使能RAID0条带化时为20-32768之间的整数；使能RAID0条带化时为160-262144之间的整数。
description.en:
The capacity in GiB. If you specify this parameter, its value must be greater than or equal to the capacity of the specified snapshot.

Valid values: an integer from 20 to 32,768 if RAID0 data striping is disabled, or an integer from 160 to 262,144 if RAID0 data striping is enabled.
The snapshot ID used to create the DBFS instance.

description.zh:
DBFS的使用场景。取值范围：

- MySQL 5.7

- PostgreSQL

- MongoDB

- Oracle RAC
description.en:
The use case for the DBFS instance. Valid values:

- MySQL 5.7

- PostgreSQL

- MongoDB

- Oracle RAC
The zone ID of the DBFS instance.

descriptions.zh:
创建数据库文件系统需要通过实名认证。请前往会员信息中进行[实名认证](https://account.console.aliyun.com/)。

创建数据库文件系统会涉及到资源计费，建议您提前了解数据库文件系统的计费方式。更多详情请参见[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149734.html)。
descriptions.en:
You must complete identity verification before you can create a DBFS. Go to your account settings and complete [identity verification](https://account.console.aliyun.com/).

Creating a DBFS incurs charges. Review the DBFS billing method before you proceed. For more information, see [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149734.html).
